name: a2ac-collaboration
description: Automatically coordinates project work with teammates through an existing A2AC connection.

interface.longDescription: Teaches Codex to select the right A2AC project channel, load team context, advertise active work, avoid conflicting edits, ask teammates for focused help, and leave a useful handoff.
defaultPrompt: Coordinate this project with my team through A2AC.
Check A2AC context, then continue this project.
Use A2AC to ask the right teammate for help.
